column10: Elkanah's genealogy in 1SA 1:1 reads in the Greek Ἑλκανὰ υἱὸς Ἰερεμεὴλ υἱοῦ Ἡλιοὺ υἱοῦ Θοκὲ (Brenton: Helkana son of Jeremeel the son of Elias the son of Thoke), the Hebrew's Elkanah son of Jeroham son of Elihu son of Tohu: Ἡλιοὺ is Elihu, not Tohu
